title: 05-inner-dialogue
prompt:
Design a radical, inventive, high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE concept for a Russian online psychology conference. This is a functioning-looking website with legible navigation, headline, date and registration CTA, NOT a poster, not a moodboard, not a browser in a frame. Show edge-to-edge website, first screen plus a glimpse of the next scene below, wide 4:3 canvas. An experimental cultural-event digital studio made this: surprise, controlled chaos, oversized photographic cutouts, daring scale and spatial storytelling. No familiar SaaS layout, no neat equal cards, no left-copy/right-portrait template, no carousel or fan of photo cards, no large rounded-corner section containers, no graph paper, no grid background, no notebooks or school supplies, no generic blobs or sparkles, no gradient typography. Russian typography: modern Cyrillic sans serif with personality, medium weight, sentence case, NOT uppercase except АСП. Crisp full headline EXACTLY: «Как превратить знания из вуза в первую практику». Keep the ENTIRE phrase readable, no obscured letters, no cropped words, no swapped words. Exact small content: «Студенческая конференция 2.0», «21 ноября 2026 · онлайн», «Участие бесплатно». Exact CTA: «Зарегистрироваться бесплатно». Header logo АСП; links «Программа», «Спикеры», «Участие». Small gift line «Карта психологических подходов — после регистрации». Palette: off-white, almost-black violet #292338, rich purple #7954D4, pale lilac. Design is playful and editorial, not corporate or school-themed. Don't invent endorsements, speaker names or statistics. Composition itself communicates moving from theory to working with clients. All images illustrative, professionally art-directed, physically convincing.
Concept «В голове перед стартом». A kinetic typographic editorial COLLAGE covering a white webpage as a deliberately art-directed messy conversation. Main heading entire exact sentence in 3 balanced enormous dark violet lines in the CENTER, offset a little left; it must remain the strongest intact readable anchor. Around it, not covering it, overlapping fragments of different scale and orientation: the huge handwritten violet question «А я готов?» near top right; typeset «Какой метод?» tilted slightly in the left margin; «Где первый клиент?» diagonally below the main headline; «Сколько стоит моя работа?» in smaller straight text at right. These are loose text, not chips, buttons, or sticky notes. Four raw-edged photographic CUTOUTS at radically different scales hold the composition: isolated hand with microphone enters from left edge; tightly cropped adult eyes looking to one side in a thin photographic slit near top; two people talking in a small black-and-white rectangular documentary crop near lower left; large full-colour adult woman shoulder and profile cropped by far right edge. Not a single hero portrait in a box. Add one long thin tangled violet cable physically weaving BETWEEN these fragments; under the hero it resolves into three clean lines leading to three programme track names. Lots of white, black, saturated violet. No doodles, tape, notebook, paper grid, question marks scattered as filler, or badges. Navigation is exceptionally minimal across top, date in one calm row, prominent solid purple CTA sits in a clean white clearing immediately below headline. Lower 25% shifts to a clean pale lilac section with left large text «Из вопросов — в свой маршрут»; right a selected question control «Не знаю, с чего начать» and visible chosen track «С чего начать». Controlled chaos ABOVE, deliberate order BELOW is the storytelling. Uneven rhythm, modern art magazine meets experimental digital event. Do not make it tidy and symmetric.
New art direction after studying Young Con festival: amplify the disruptive human scale, dramatic cropping, section-breaking layers and visual wit. Main canvas warm light grey with near-black-purple type. The giant human profile must break across both section boundaries. A vivid purple circle cropped by edge can frame the photographic profile, not a generic decorative blob. Bold type scale jumps, physical close-up texture, diagonal visual forces, compact eccentric microcaptions. Aim for a cultural festival identity and fashion editorial with one expressive visual idea. Keep all important words comfortably legible and normal case, no all-caps. Deliberate contrast between densely layered corners and a calm clear headline. Avoid timid generic corporate coaching atmosphere.
purpose: Concept exploration. Unapproved. Generated secondary text needs editorial correction; use official Academy name and supplied programme tracks.
